blocks.text: Edwin Hubble ne yeh dikha kar modern cosmology (universe ki science) ki foundation (bunyaad) rakhi ke galaxies zameen se door ja rahi hain, aur un ki velocity faasle ke saath barhti hai. Yani galaxy jitni door ho, utni hi tezi se door jati nazar aati hai. Is observation (ghaur se dekhi gayi baat) se Hubble's law bana, jo kehta hai:

blocks.title: Hubble's law
blocks.text: Galaxy ki recession velocity (door jane ki velocity) v zameen se us ke faasle d ke directly proportional hai (faasla dugna to velocity dugni).

blocks.title: Do you know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Hubble ki discovery (daryaft) se pehle zyada tar scientists samajhte the ke universe static hai (aik jaisa, na phailne wala). Hubble's law ne yeh khayal ulat diya: universe ki aik shuruaat thi, aur isi se Big Bang theory bani.
Yahan v recession velocity aur d faasla hai. Hₒ ko Hubble's constant kehte hain; is ki value 2.3×10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹ hai.

Fig. 21.6 Hubble's law ka graph hai. Is mein galaxies ka redshift (yani door jane ki velocity) aur zameen se un ka faasla straight line (linear) ka relation dikhate hain. Faasla barhe to recession velocity bhi barhti hai, jo phailte universe ka mazboot saboot hai. Is straight line ka slope (dhalwan) Hubble constant (H₀) hai, jo batata hai ke universe kis rate (raftar) se phail raha hai.

blocks.alt: Graph: vertical axis Recession velocity, horizontal axis Distance. Bohat se dots origin se guzarti straight line ke qareeb hain, beech mein zyada ghane.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.6: Hubble's law ka graph (kitab ki Figure 21.6 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.prompt: Aik galaxy ham se bohat tezi se door ja rahi hai. Hubble's law ke mutabiq yeh us ke faasle ke bare mein kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Woh bohat door hai, kyunke v = Hₒd: zyada recession velocity ka matlab zyada faasla.

blocks.text: Universe ki tamam galaxies aik doosre se door ja rahi hain. Kisi aur galaxy mein baitha observer (dekhne wala) bhi yahi dekhega. Yeh is liye ho raha hai ke khud space stretch ho rahi hai (phail rahi hai). Scientists Big Bang expansion samjhane ke liye aksar phoolte balloon (ghubbare) ki misal dete hain (Fig. 21.7). Balloon ki surface par bane dots galaxies hain, aur balloon ki skin (khaal) ko kitab 'four dimensional space-time' kehti hai. Jab balloon phoolta hai to har dot baqi dots ko apne se door jata 'dekhta' hai, bilkul jaise galaxies space mein door hoti hain. Is model se do baatein samajh aati hain. Pehli: hum universe mein kaheen bhi hon, galaxies ham se door jati nazar aayengi. Yani expansion (phailao) har jagah ho raha hai aur koi khaas centre nahi; zameen universe ka centre nahi. Doosri: universe abhi phail raha hai, to hum zehan mein waqt ko ulta chala sakte hain. Is ka matlab hai:

items: past (guzre waqt) mein galaxies aik doosre ke zyada qareeb thin.
aur peeche jayen to saara matter (maadda) aik bohat chhoti, dense aur garam halat mein daba hua tha.

blocks.alt: Teen dark green balloons, chhote se bare; har aik par lines aur wahi roshan dots usi jagah; bare balloon par dots aik doosre se zyada door.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.7: phailte universe ki misal: balloon phoolne par dots door hote hain (kitab ki Figure 21.7 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Aasan lafzon mein
blocks.text: Balloon ki misal mein do-dimensional skin hamari teen-dimensional space ki jagah hai: dots khud balloon par nahi chalte, balke un ke darmiyan ki skin phailti hai. Isi tarah galaxies ke darmiyan space barh rahi hai.

Yahi idea Big Bang Theory ki bunyaad hai, jis ke mutabiq universe taqreeban 13.8 billion (1380 crore) saal pehle aik initial singularity (shuru ki aik nuqte jaisi, bohat hi dense halat) se shuru hua aur tab se phail raha hai. Hubble's law is baat ka mazboot observational evidence (dekh kar mila saboot) hai ke universe static nahi balke phail raha hai, aur yeh Big Bang model ke aham pillars (sutoon) mein se aik hai.
Big Bang se aaj tak universe ki evolution (dheere dheere tabdeeli) aur expansion ki approximate (taqreebi) timeline Fig. 21.8 mein di gayi hai.

blocks.alt: Neeche Big Bang se oopar phailta cone. Stages aur waqt: Big Bang, 0; Recombination Era, 380 hazaar saal; First stars appear, 30 crore saal; Early galaxies, 1 arab saal; Modern galaxies (Acceleration), Today. Chhote labels: First structure formation; Expanding proto-clusters; Current Era: Lambda-CDM, aur galaxies ke door hone ke arrows.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.8: Big Bang se aaj tak universe ki evolution ki approximate timeline (kitab ki Figure 21.8 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche se oopar waqt barhta hai aur cone ki chaurai universe ka phailao dikhati hai. Pehle atoms (Recombination Era, 380 hazaar saal), phir pehle stars (30 crore saal), phir galaxies (1 arab saal), aur aaj, taqreeban 13.8 arab saal baad, phailao tez ho raha hai (Acceleration). Arrows galaxies ke darmiyan barhte faasle dikhate hain.

blocks.prompt: Hₒ = 2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹ le kar universe ki age (umar) 1/Hₒ se andaza lagayein.
blocks.explanation: 1/Hₒ = 1/(2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹) = 4.3 × 10¹⁷ s. Aik saal mein taqreeban 3.16 × 10⁷ s hain, is liye yeh taqreeban 1.4 × 10¹⁰ saal (14 arab saal) hai, jo mani hui value 13.8 arab saal ke qareeb hai.

blocks.text: Steps of satellite remote sensing (satellite remote sensing ke qadam)

Satellite remote sensing aik taqatwar technology hai jis mein orbit (madar, ghoomne ka raasta) mein ghoomte spacecraft par lage sensors space se zameen ke environment ki monitoring (nigrani) aur analysis (jaanch) karte hain. Is se scientists deforestation (jangal kaatna), climate change, samandar ka temperature aur atmosphere ki composition (hawa mein kaun si gases kitni) dekh sakte hain. Zameen par khare ho kar kiye jane wale tareeqon ke muqable mein yeh bohat bara area aik saath dekhti hai aur baar baar observation karti hai, is liye lambe arse tak environment ki monitoring mumkin hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Sooraj (Energy source) zameen (Target) par chamakta hai. Zameen se rays satellite (Sensor) tak jati hain, raaste mein aik jagah har taraf scatter hoti hain. Satellite signals dish aur buildings (Processing station) ko bhejta hai; mota arrow data computer par baithe shakhs (Analysis) tak aur phir rangeen map wale laptop (Application) tak le jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.9: remote sensing ka process (tareeqa) (kitab ki Figure 21.9 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure ki tarteeb neeche ke chhe steps jaisi hai: (1) Sooraj source hai, (2) raaste mein atmosphere radiation ko scatter karti hai, (3) radiation zameen (target) se takrati hai, (4) satellite ka sensor wapas aane wali radiation record karta hai, (5) data processing station ko bheja jata hai, (6) phir analysis aur application.
Satellite remote sensing (SRS) ke steps yeh hain:

items: Source and Illumination (source aur roshni): SRS ka pehla aur sab se aham hissa source hai jo target (jis cheez ko dekhna hai) ko roshan karta hai. Yeh electromagnetic radiation ki shakal mein hota hai (aam taur par Sooraj ki roshni).
Atmosphere: Source se nikalne ke baad radiation atmosphere se guzarti hai aur us se interact karti hai (asar leti deti hai), maslan scattering (bikharna) ya reflection (lautna).
Interaction with Target (target se takrao): Atmosphere ke baad radiation target se takrati hai; yeh interaction target aur radiation dono ki properties (khoobiyon) par depend karta hai.
Recording with Sensor (sensor se record): Target se emit ya reflect hone wali radiation sensors record karte hain jo door (remote) hain, yani target ko chhoote nahi.

Transmission and Reception (bhejna aur receive karna): Sensor ka record kiya hua data receiving station ko bheja jata hai, jahan use images (tasveeron) jaisi samajh aane wali shakal mein badla jata hai.
Interpretation and Analysis (matlab nikalna aur jaanch): Tayyar image se information hasil karne ke liye us ka electronic ya digital tareeqe se matlab nikala jata hai.
Hubble's law: v = Hₒd (21.5); Hₒ = 2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹.
Balloon model: har jagah phailao, koi centre nahi; waqt ulta chalayen to sab aik garam, dense halat mein.
Big Bang taqreeban 13.8 arab saal pehle; remote sensing ke chhe steps.
